title: Depression is a disease of civilization: Stephen Ilardi at TEDxEmory
summary: Clinical psychologist Stephen Ilardi argues depression is a disease of modern civilization and presents a lifestyle-based program to treat it without drugs. Topics include exercise, sunlight, omega-3s and social connection.
why: HN recommends it in depression threads as a practical, non-medication approach with concrete takeaways.
